theorems.name: Submission.allard_tc_fbl_plane_cutoff_limits
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n), Tendsto (fun k : ℕ ↦ ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), max 0 (1 - ((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (‖y‖ - 1)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) atTop (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n).toReal) ∧ Tendsto (fun k : ℕ ↦ ∫ y in (T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), min 1 (((k : ℝ) + 1) * max 0 (1 - ‖y‖)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))) atTop (𝓝 (unitBallVolume n).toReal)
